_about: Known model families. An uploaded workflow is matched by its model file names; the profile fills in what the workflow file can't say (LoRA support, picture limits, video frame rules, a sampling hint). Values here never overwrite the workflow's own steps/CFG/sampler. Sampling numbers come from the owner's tested PC Launcher setups; leave a field out when it isn't known rather than guessing.

families.name: MiniMax H3
families.sampling_note: MiniMax H3 image: 6 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple (distilled). 8 steps also works well.

families.name: MiniMax H3
families.sampling_note: MiniMax H3 video: 8 steps with the turbo LoRA, CFG 1.5.

families.name: Krea 2
families.sampling_note: Krea 2 Turbo: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple (the official template). Raw model: 28 steps, CFG 3.5. Krea 2 Edit: 10 steps on Turbo, 40 steps CFG 3.5 on Raw.

families.name: Qwen Image
families.sampling_note: Qwen Image (2.1 / Edit): uses the workflow's own steps and CFG. Edit models take up to 3 pictures.

families.name: FLUX.2 Klein
families.sampling_note: FLUX.2 Klein 9B: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler (distilled). Edits use the pictures as references.

families.name: FLUX.3 Klein
families.sampling_note: FLUX.3 Klein: distilled 16 steps, CFG 1, er_sde. Base model: 25 steps, CFG 3.5, euler.

families.name: MOSS
families.sampling_note: MOSS SFT: 25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde. KroMOSS and MOSS Base: 50 steps, CFG 3, euler. Turbo model, or the 8-step DMD2 LoRA: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler. Best at 1-2 MP.

families.name: LTX Video
families.sampling_note: LTX 2.x distilled: the workflow's own sigmas decide the steps; CFG 1.
